test_command: cmake --build build --config Debug --target test_exe > $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Set-Location build/bin/Debug; ./test_exe.exe --gtest_filter=InventoryContextActionsTest.*

mutations.catches: a worn item offered Use, which puts it on again rather than taking it off
an empty slot offering to drop what it does not hold
a category heading offered item actions, so a menu opens on a row that is not an item
Cancel somewhere other than last, so the dismiss entry moves under the pointer by surprise
